explanation.en: Thank you for generating the export file(s). Please ensure that the results URL is secured with a password before sharing it with the intended recipients. You can share the secured URL through this interface, and the app will notify the designated recipients (e.g., the Request Applicant and, if applicable, the Final User). Alternatively, you can share the URL and credentials separately using the 'Credentials Sharing Tool,' email, or other communication methods. We recommend using the 'Credentials Sharing Tool' for enhanced security. Recipient details, such as email addresses, can be found in the 'Results' section of the app. Depending on the request characteristics, an authorized Final User may review the results data, combine exports from all the bridgeheads involved in the request to generate new results, or perform analyses on the data and share only the analysis results. If there is no Final User, the Request Applicant remains the primary recipient of the results.
explanation.de: Vielen Dank für die Erstellung der Exportdateien. Sichern Sie die Ergebnis-URL vor dem Teilen mit einem Passwort und geben Sie URL und Zugangsdaten immer getrennt weiter.

explanation.en: Please wait until the exports from the Bridgehead Admins are available. Once the exports are ready, you can either check the results or perform an analysis to create new results, depending on the request specifications. If you are only reviewing the results, mark them as accepted in the app once you have checked them. If changes are required, contact the Bridgehead Admin(s). You can find their contact information in the app. If you need to create a results file based on the exports, secure the results URL with a password before sharing it. You can save the URL in the app, and the system will notify the Request Applicant automatically. Alternatively, you can send the URL and credentials separately. You can send the URL by sharing it directly (outside the app). For the credentials, you can use the 'Credentials Sharing Tool' or send them independently through email or other methods. The 'Credentials Sharing Tool' can only send the credentials, not the results URL. Never send the results URL and the credentials together. Always send them separately for enhanced security.
explanation.de: Warten Sie, bis die Exporte der Bridgehead-Administratoren verfügbar sind. Prüfen oder analysieren Sie die Ergebnisse und speichern Sie eine gegebenenfalls passwortgeschützte Ergebnis-URL in der Anwendung.
